timeline.summary: Ziatora addresses an assembly of workers, attacking the Cabaretti, Brokers and Obscura.
timeline.quote: "The Cabaretti demand too much for this Crescendo without spreading its benefits.

timeline.summary: Kros learns from Jolene's mind that the Obscura abducted her and set a trap to start a war between the Brokers and Riveteers.
timeline.quote: "This is all a trap, she's the bait."

citation.text: "The Contract Breaker" by Tobias S. Buckell. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Kamiz foils a Broker agent's contract on Tivit with a mirror and learns the Riveteers smashed a new halo stained glass.
timeline.quote: The binding magic reflected to the agent and fizzled.

citation.text: "What You Expect to See" by Kaitlyn Zivanovich. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Mar 2022.

timeline.summary: Officers report Jetmir gravely wounded, the Cabaretti neutralized and other families compromised; Ob Nixilis orders the families' heads and a hunt for the Font.
timeline.quote: "I want the families' heads. All of them.

citation.work: Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font
citation.text: "Streets of New Capenna | Episode 4: The Font" by Elise Kova. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: A Riveteer transport crashes into the car; Anhelo stabs Severo and survives the wreck.
timeline.quote: A huge Riveteer transport crashed into them like an angry rhox.

citation.text: "The Family Man" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Riveteers who own the Halo in the trunk surround the battered Anhelo, who resolves to fight his way to the wedding.
timeline.quote: "You want to dance?" he slurred.

citation.text: "The Family Man" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Toluz appears with the shadow generator's darkness and wipes out the Riveteers, saving Anhelo.
timeline.quote: When it was all over, she was the only one left standing

citation.text: "The Family Man" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: The train stops and Riveteers blow up the rails, then the viashino Ognis tells the passengers she is looking for Henzie's goods.
timeline.quote: "There's somethin' our old pal Henzie owes us, and he knows it

citation.text: "Alley Cat Blues" by Rhiannon Rasmussen. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Kitt flees across the Mezzio rooftops pursued by Ognis and two male viashino.
timeline.quote: the roof shuddered under the shocking weight of the viashino

citation.text: "Alley Cat Blues" by Rhiannon Rasmussen. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Pigeons distract Riveteer lookouts and Kitt catches a train down to the Mezzio.

citation.text: "Alley Cat Blues" by Rhiannon Rasmussen. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Kitt performs at the Red Room, spotting Ognis and the Riveteers in the audience, and pledges loyalty to the Cabaretti with a song mocking them.
timeline.quote: Pack those vials one by one, up to Park Heights, on the run, bye, bye, boiler

citation.text: "Alley Cat Blues" by Rhiannon Rasmussen. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 5 Apr 2022.

timeline.summary: Giada makes Halo to heal Jetmir, but Riveteers and Maestro assassins burst in, and Elspeth and Vivien break free of their shackles.
timeline.quote: With a thought, her magic cracked open the locks

timeline.summary: The gangs collapse the structure holding Park Heights on Atraxa, killing her; angels then leave via omenpaths for New Phyrexia and are stranded on Zhalfir.
timeline.quote: The gangs formulated a plan to collapse the structure holding Park Heights on Atraxa, which was successful in killing her.

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Capenna", section "The Second Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Riveteers fight back in Park Heights, and Elspeth decides New Capenna has its defenders and is not the place to intervene.
timeline.quote: "This isn't the place," she says.
